verdict.rationale: E2B provides building blocks for autonomous background work: the CLI can run commands in the background (`--background`), sandboxes can run for up to 24 hours and be paused and resumed with state intact, lifecycle webhooks notify external servers, and coding agents such as Claude Code can run inside sandboxes. There is no evidence of a first-party automation feature (scheduling, triggers or recurring jobs), so the user must orchestrate automations with their own code or CI. Missing for 10: built-in scheduling/cron or event-triggered automations, a managed way to set up recurring autonomous runs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of long-running background automation.
